svg.title: 4x4 matrix keypad module
svg.desc: Illustration of a membrane-style 4 by 4 matrix keypad with a black body. Sixteen buttons arranged in four columns and four rows: columns one through three are numbers 1-9, star, 0, and pound (blue with two red buttons for star and pound), and column four has amber buttons labeled A, B, C, D. Eight yellow ribbon wires lead down into a black connector block ending in eight gray pins with dark tips.
